---

### 1.  First substitution  

Put \(u=x^{4}\;(x\neq0)\).  
Then \(du=4x^{3}dx\) and \(dx=\dfrac{du}{4x^{3}}=\dfrac{du}{4u^{3/4}}\).

\[
I=\int \frac{1}{x(1+x^{4})^{1/4}}\,dx
   =\int\frac{1}{u^{1/4}(1+u)^{1/4}}\,
        \frac{du}{4u^{3/4}}
   =\frac14\int\frac{du}{u(1+u)^{1/4}} .
\]

---

### 2.  Second substitution  

Let 
\[
w=(1+u)^{1/4}\qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad u=w^{4}-1,
\qquad du=4w^{3}dw .
\]

Hence  

\[
\frac14\int\frac{du}{u(1+u)^{1/4}}
  =\frac14\int\frac{4w^{3}dw}{\;(w^{4}-1)\;w}
  =\int\frac{w^{2}}{w^{4}-1}\,dw .
\]

---

### 3.  Partial‑fraction decomposition  

\[
\frac{w^{2}}{w^{4}-1}
= \frac{1}{2\,(w^{2}+1)}-\frac{1}{4\,(w+1)}+\frac{1}{4\,(w-1)} .
\]

Therefore  

\[
\int\frac{w^{2}}{w^{4}-1}\,dw
= \frac12\int\frac{dw}{w^{2}+1}
  -\frac14\int\frac{dw}{w+1}
  +\frac14\int\frac{dw}{w-1}.
\]

Integrating,

\[
\int\frac{w^{2}}{w^{4}-1}\,dw
= \frac12\arctan w
  +\frac14\ln|w-1|
  -\frac14\ln|w+1|
  +C .
\]

Combine the logarithms:

\[
\int\frac{w^{2}}{w^{4}-1}\,dw
= \frac12\arctan w
  +\frac14\ln\Bigl|\frac{w-1}{w+1}\Bigr|
  +C .
\]

---

### 4.  Back‑substitution  

Recall \(w=(1+u)^{1/4}=(1+x^{4})^{1/4}\). Thus

\[
I = \frac12\arctan\!\bigl((1+x^{4})^{1/4}\bigr)
    +\frac14\ln\!\Bigl|\frac{(1+x^{4})^{1/4}-1}
                            {(1+x^{4})^{1/4}+1}\Bigr|
    +C .
\]

\]
